sources.title: Hollow Knight Silksong physical editions mention multiple "free content packs" incoming, and call Sea of Sorrow a "giant expansion"
sources.text: More than a year after its initial release, physical versions of Hollow Knight: Silksong are finally arriving on players' doorsteps. It's the same brilliant and sometimes thrillingly cruel Metroidvania Eurogamer gave five stars to , except this time a pack-in booklet seemingly reveals the existence of multiple "free content packs" alongside the Sea of Sorrow DLC. Hollow Knight: Silksong's physical editions were originally set to be delivered from 10th November, but some early handovers have given us a peek inside the box. Redditor Me_975 posted pictures of their Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, and there's a few interesting tidbits tucked away - most notably in the manual's chapter on Content Packs. "The world of Hollow Knight: Silksong will expand with free content packs," the booklet reads. "Prepare for even more adventures filled with new friends, new abilities, and new ferocious foes!" Developer Team Cherry confirmed plans for post-launch Silksong support last year, but remained pretty tight-lipped about what exactly that would look like. The indie outfit then announced the nautically themed Sea of Sorrow expansion , though we now have proper confirmation there's more content packs still to come, which shouldn't be a huge shocker considering all the free post-launch love Hollow Knight (the first one) received. Speaking of Sea of Sorrow, that's mentioned here too: "In the first giant expansion, voyage across and beneath a salt-stricken ocean brimming with mystery and menace." Sea of Sorrow's original release window was a vague 2026 - time's a-ticking, Team Cherry. Still no release date so far, but the booklet does say it's "Coming Soon." Of course, Team Cherry are quite infamous for working on games until they balloon wildly out of control. After all, Silksong was once upon a time intended to be a Hollow Knight DLC, but with games this detailed, I can't really complain about waiting a little extra. If you are interested in owning Silksong physically, it comes with a big map of Pharloom and the rest of the booklet also includes some really lovely art seemingly ripped straight from the game, as well.

sources.name: Polygon
sources.title: Even More Free DLC for Hollow Knight: Silksong Might Be on the Way
sources.text: Sea of Sorrow is also described as the game’s ‘first’ expansion After approximately 100 years of waiting, Hollow Knight: Silksong was released last fall. Players were eager to jump into it as Silksong hit a peak of nearly 600,000 concurrent players on Steam alone. Critics adored it too as Silksong was nominated for several end-of-year awards and won a handful of them, such as Best Action/Adventure Game at The Game Awards . Around that time, Team Cherry announced it was working on a new Silksong expansion called Sea of Sorrow . Physical editions of Silksong are out this week, and some players have gotten their hands on them early. Inside those copies are a map and a little booklet (remember those?), and that booklet has a section hinting at more free Silksong DLC. A Reddit user shared pictures of their physical Nintendo Switch 2 copy of Hollow Knight: Silksong , showcasing the booklet. "The world of Hollow Knight: Silksong will expand with free content packs," it reads. "Prepare for even more adventures filled with new friends, new abilities, and new ferocious foes!" The wording of the "Content Packs" sections makes it seem like these "free content packs" are possibly considered separate from the Sea of Sorrow expansion, though that too will be free for players. The booklet also calls Sea of Sorrow the game's "first giant expansion." The "first" here is interesting as Silksong fans will surely hope that means "first of many" as opposed to "first and only." Sea of Sorrow was announced last December with a very vague 2026 release window. The booklet simply says it's "coming soon," with some Reddit users wondering if that means it's been quietly delayed. However, it's possible the text for that booklet was written months ago and Team Cherry went with a generic "coming soon" descriptor and that the DLC is, in fact, coming soon. Of course, 2026 is almost wrapped, and Sea of Sorrow is without a firm release date. Team Cherry marches to the beat of its own drum, and announced Silksong 's release date two weeks before the game dropped, so who knows if Team Cherry is planning the same strategy for its expansion. After Silksong began as an expansion for the original Hollow Knight before blossoming into a full-on sequel, who knows if Sea of Sorrow will even remain an expansion when it comes out — whenever that is.

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong players jump at word of "free content packs" and "first giant expansion"
sources.text: We're still waiting for Team Cherry to say something, anything at all Hollow Knight: Silksong has a new physical edition, and early arrivals reveal a surprise message from developer Team Cherry regarding additional content coming to the game in the months and, seemingly, years ahead. Metroidvania marketing man Matthew Griffin reminds fans that "Hollow Knight: Silksong (Standard Edition) is arriving soon on November 10th." It comes with a user manual, a hand-drawn map, and reversible cover art. We're most interested in that user manual, which ends with a section on "Content Packs," per images shared online by fans who got their physical copy a smidge early. "The world of Hollow Knight: Silksong will expand with free content packs," this page of the manual reads. "Prepare for even more adventures filled with new friends, new abilities, and new ferocious foes!" The plurality of this promise is what's raised some eyebrows. After the many DLCs Hollow Knight received, there was little doubt that Team Cherry would add a truckload of content to Silksong. This is not a studio known for restraint. But how would all those ideas be expressed? Official word of several "free content packs" containing multiple "new abilities" for protagonist Hornet has predictably excited fans. The manual continues: "In the first giant expansion, voyage across and beneath a salt-stricken ocean brimming with mystery and menace." Here again, fans linger on this being the first giant expansion for Silksong. Hollow Knight also got multiple DLC packs – Hidden Dreams, The Grimm Troupe, Lifeblood, and Godmaster – adding bosses, items, areas, storylines, and exacting arena challenges. Previous comments from developers Ari Gibson and William Pellen suggested Silksong may receive a similar variety of additional content, with Sea of Sorrow expected to be a Grimm Troupe-like shotgun blast of experiences. The manual concludes with a Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow emblem that reads, "Coming soon." You'll note that this, like everything else Team Cherry has said, doesn't say when soon is. Sign up to our Switch 2 Spotlight newsletter to make sure you get the very latest news on Nintendo's new console and its games every week Last year, Team Cherry announced Sea of Sorrow and charted a 2026 launch. Apart from a February update on a port for the original Hollow Knight and a March post confirming expanded Silksong language support, the studio hasn't said anything else on its blog or social feeds all year. Pellen previously said Team Cherry would be more communicative, and we can see how that panned out. Three blog posts in a year, dare we dream? In a read that's only slightly generous, it's possible that this blank phrasing, used in place of a definitive release date, is just generalist wording or an artifact of this physical edition's production. Maybe Team Cherry didn't want to announce anything major in such a limited product. But this does read like a step back from the 2026 target in the expansion's reveal trailer. Team Cherry is quiet and spontaneous enough that a Sea of Sorrow shadow drop, or at least a release date with very little notice, wouldn't surprise me. Silksong's launch also came out of nowhere, giving countless other games just two weeks to flee the blast radius . But 2026 is rapidly coming to a close and we haven't heard a peep from Team Cherry about the expansion, so I also wouldn't be surprised if this manual does, as players fear, herald a delay into 2027. Recent YouTube comments on Sea of Sorrow's trailer tell the whole story. "Team Cherry...? Where are you...?" wonders one viewer. The vibes are very similar to those around The Duskbloods , a Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive FromSoftware game long said to be releasing in 2026. As the months flew by without any official word, a delay seemed more and more likely, though FromSoftware also notably had some negative test feedback to respond to. Lo and behold, The Duskbloods was delayed. But much like FromSoftware, Team Cherry can pretty much do what it wants, when it wants, and millions of fans will show up anyway. Katana Zero pulls a Hollow Knight: Silksong - the beloved action game's DLC is now "the size of a full sequel" after 7 years of development Austin has been a game journalist for 12 years, having freelanced for the likes of PC Gamer, Eurogamer, IGN, Sports Illustrated, and more while finishing his journalism degree. He's been with GamesRadar+ since 2019. They've yet to realize his position is a cover for his career-spanning Destiny column, and he's kept the ruse going with a lot of news and the occasional feature, all while playing as many roguelikes as possible. sources.title: How to beat the Treasure Chest Game in Zelda Ocarina of Time
sources.text: The Treasure Chest Shop in the OOT Remake can be beaten with luck - or a special item The Treasure Chest Game in the Zelda Ocarina of Time remake has Link forced to pick between a pair of chests five times in a row, with a heart container as the potential reward. If you pick incorrectly at any point you lose, but there is a way (two ways, in fact) to beat the system and get this substantial reward early in the Switch 2 OOT remake. If you want to know how, I'll explain where to find the Treasure Chest Shop in Ocarina of Time, and how to beat the treasure chest game easily. Around the corner, you can find the Zelda Ocarina of Time Happy Mask Shop . Check out our guide on the quest tied to it, and how you can hand out the masks to those who need them! The Treasure Chest Shop in OOT is located on the West Side of Hyrule Castle Town, at the spot shown above. However, it can only be accessed at Night. If it's daytime and you don't want to wait, head North along the alley to the building with the blue door, which will have a bed you can rest in to change the time of day. The Treasure Chest Game is simple: you'll be shown a pair of chests, one of which is right, and one of which is wrong. If you pick correctly, you move forward to the next round. If you pick wrong, you lose the game. If you can pass five rounds, you'll get a heart container. The problem is, the chests looks identical, and each attempt costs you 10 Rupees. Here are three methods that will give you a chance at success: Find out where to armor up with our guide on how to get the Shield and Sword in Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake , or check out how to cheer up Darunia and unlock explosive power in our walkthrough for Goron City in Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake . © GamesRadar+. sources.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Scarier Than Ever on Switch 2
sources.text: When I first encountered The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time growing up, it scared the crap out of me. The screeching Redeads, the skittering spiders, the disembodied hands — it was basically a horror movie to a young kid’s eyes. I’m older and harder to spook now, of course, which means that I knew the Nintendo 64 game’s fresh Switch 2 remake was bound to hit differently. Surely I’d laugh at everything that used to creep me out and realize that I was scared of a glorified cartoon! How wrong I was. Ocarina of Time ’s remake is arguably even more of a horror show than its 1998 predecessor. Though some goofy voice acting might lure you into a false sense of security, the faithful remake uses the technical power of the Switch 2 for chaotic evil. Every creepy crawler that may have freaked you out in the ‘90s has gotten whatever the opposite of a glow-up is. The remake is terrifying — and I am in full support of that evil creative decision. The important thing to understand about Ocarina of Time if you're totally new to it is that it has the energy of a Grimms’ fairy tale . You know, the kind that revolves around an evil witch who cooks children alive. Kind of whimsical, kind of messed up. For every funny little moment in Ocarina of Time , like a scooting Zora king or a dancing Goron, you’ve also got a quest where you have to drop into a man’s grave after learning he died after Link traveled forward in time. It’s dark, though in a very family-friendly Nintendo way. That said, the remake really emphasizes just how unnerving the original game can be. Nintendo didn’t hold back when redesigning some of its scariest monsters. Take Redeads, for instance. The creatures are essentially zombies that lurch towards Link slowly, but can paralyze him with fear by letting out a blood-curdling screech. If they catch him, they can wrap around his little head and squeeze the life out of him, a traumatizing image for a ‘90s kid. That all holds true in the remake, except now you can also see every branch-like vein across the skin on their rotten, wooden bodies. Their faces are nightmare fuel too, with more detail put into the red mask that hides whatever is happening up there. Better if I don’t know, I reckon. Deku Babas? Those now have crooked, gnashing teeth and tongues that look like overgrown gourds. Gibdos? They went from looking like basic mummies to Curly from Mouthwashing , with a dead eye peeking out from rough bandages. Floormasters? The sentient hands now have protruding bones, just to screw with you. Moblins? They have butt cheeks now. (That part isn’t scary, it’s just kinda weird, I suppose.) Everything is a grotesque little freak that I would like to squash with a hammer. And then, there are the spiders. Be warned: Readers with arachnophobia might want to stop reading here. Ocarina of Time ’s Skulltulas have always been the series’ most skin-crawling monsters. They’re basically giant spiders with cracked skulls for bodies. Predictably, they are abominations here, thanks to their furry little legs that make them even grosser. Gold Skulltulas are equally disgusting, even though Nintendo toned down their loud skittering sounds that made them especially scary in 1998. But what’s really been brought to a whole new circle of hell is the House of Skulltula. It’s home to a cursed family who have been transformed into Skulltulas, turning each of them into a half-spider, half-man situation straight out of The Fly . They look so horrific in the remake that you will wish you could put them out of their misery. You can see their warped faces under their skull bodies. They each have a human arm dangling off their spider legs. It’s the most hellish sight I have ever seen in a kid’s game, and I am proud of Nintendo for allowing it to happen. Not everything about the remake is scarier. Like Likes are still slimy little freaks, but their additional detail makes them less scary than the unknowable blobs of the original game. Hyrule Castle Town is less unnerving post-time skip now that the original game’s Resident Evil-like fixed camera angles are no more. In general, the overall atmosphere of the remake skews more towards that of an animated cartoon, which takes some bite out of the N64 version. I still prefer the original game, with its low-poly textures and more muted colors, for that reason. Even so, the commitment to creepiness is just one of the reasons that Nintendo’s remake works so well. It understands what made the original game special, and works to amplify that vibe rather than wash it away. It’s similar to how developer Grezzo handled its Link’s Awakening remake, leaning on toy-like design and whimsy to retain the lightness of the original game. The most important — and hardest — thing to get right in a remake is aura, and Ocarina of Time nails the assignment in that respect.

sources.title: James Gunn And Peter Safran Step Down As DC Studios Co-Presidents Two Years Into The DC Universe
sources.text: After only three DC Universe movies and three TV shows, James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down as co-presidents of DC Studios. âFour years ago, we set out to unite DC under one creative vision. In that time, we helped restore Superman to the heart of DC, while opening new doors and telling new stories in film and television with Peacemaker , Creature Commandos , Lanterns and Clayface ,â Gunn and Safran said in a statement to Variety . âWeâre immensely proud of the team that turned that ambition into something real, including the actors, crews and executives we had the opportunity to collaborate with. Weâve shared a creative history with Jeremy going back to Marvel, and weâre eager to see the perspective he brings to DCâs next chapter. Weâre excited to return to what drew us to this job in the first place, which is telling the stories we love, including the next chapter of Clark and Lexâs journey in Man of Tomorrow .â VarietyÂ reports that the pair will be replaced by Marvel veteran Jeremy Latcham, who has credits onÂ Guardians of the Galaxy ,Â Avengers , and Spider-Man films. âJeremy brings a deep reverence for DC and its passionate fanbase, recognizing that they are the very foundation of this storied, multigenerational brand,â said Skydance Motion Picture Group co-chairs Dana Goldberg and Josh Greenstein. âUnder his leadership, every film and television show will be ushered from start to finish through the prism of the legions of fans who love and champion it. Jeremyâs track record exemplifies the excellence he will bring to building out DC and the many beloved characters within it.â The shake-up is pretty unexpected given Gunn and Safran’s quest to get the DC cinematic universe on track had only really just begun. The pair formed DC Studios in 2022, and kicked off a new movie continuity for DC heroes with last year’s acclaimedÂ Superman . This year’sÂ Supergirl was not quite as well received and performed poorly at the box office .Â Clayface , a body horror film about the Batman villain of the same name, was released last month. On the TV side,Â Lanterns and Peacemaker were both received very well after debuting on HBO Max, though the DC Universe’s choices for some early projects had drawn a fair bit of criticism for focusing on obscure characters instead of major players like Batman and Wonder Woman. The People v. Gorilla GroddÂ is an upcoming mockumentary series starring Skyler Gisondo as Jimmy Olson after he debuted as the comic relief character in Superman . Gunn is still attached to next year’sÂ Man of Tomorrow , which he wrote and directed, but both he and Safran “will return full time to creative work” after years of overseeing the DCU’s direction. Update, 11/9/26, 1:15 p.m. Eastern:Â Gunn has released a statement on his Instagram account, confirming he is still working with DC on bothÂ Man of Tomorrow and another project he’s writing on. He leaves it open-ended on whether or not he’ll continue working with the company, saying “we’ll see where it goes after that.” Thanks to all of you who have supported me and Peter in our time as the heads of DC Studios. When I was a kid growing up in Manchester, Missouri, I used to write and draw my own comics with a mix of DC Comics characters and my own characters. Having full access to these characters to do whatever we wanted has been a dream come true. I didn’t know if I wanted this job when it was offered to me, but I just couldn’t pass up the unique opportunity. I’m glad I took the job. There have been so many highs along the way – releasing Superman and Clayface, making Peacemaker, reading the scripts to The People Vs, the entire process of Man of Tomorrow, which thus far has been the best filmmaking experience of my life, and numerous other moments. The highest of the highs have been all the talented and wonderful people I’ve worked with and grown to love: the DC Studios crew, our talented collaborators, our casts and crews, and the boisterous and hilarious fans. And the best part of all has been working with Peter Safran, the smartest and most competent person I know. You’ve been the best partner a person could ask for, and, more so, a truly good friend. But what only the closest people to me have known over the past four years is my time at DC Studios has been trying, to say the least. I dislike the at-times corporate nature of the job (thanks to Peter for taking the brunt of that). I’m always a very hard worker, but as a filmmaker I would at least get to take short breaks to unwind, and I’ve stolen even that time from both myself and my loved ones over the past four years (Jenn, I love you and I’m sorry and you don’t need to feel guilty for being the happiest of all people that I’m no longer doing this job). And the thing my ADHD hyperfocus has had the most difficulty with has been dividing my time between projects I’m incredibly passionate about and the ones I’m not so much and all the things I have to do as a studio head. So, yes, I will miss the people around me, and I will miss being the co-caretaker of these great characters, but I’m also incredibly relieved and excited to get back to pure filmmaking. That’s not to say Peter and 1 are immediately done with DC or superheroes. We have Man of Tomorrow out this summer. And we’ve just been engaged on another DC project which I’m writing, and we’ll see where it goes after that. And, of course, the characters we set up will live on. Thank you so very, very much for embracing the characters and stories we’ve put on screen. Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. sources.title: James Gunn is out at DC Studios, as former Marvel Studios executive takes over under Skydance
sources.text: James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down as co-heads of DC Studios and will be replaced by former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham James Gunn and DC Studios co-CEO Peter Safran are stepping down as the heads of DC Studios and will be replaced by former Marvel Studios executive Jeremy Latcham. Per The Hollywood Reporter , Gunn and Safran are out of the job from December 1, 2026. That's just over four years after the pair were appointed to the post. In that time, DC Studios has released three movies ( Superman , Supergirl and Clayface ) and four TV shows (Creature Commandos, Peacemaker season 2 , The Penguin and Lanterns ). Projects currently in the pipeline include Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow , Jimmy Olsen series The People v. Gorilla Grodd, Creature Commandos season 2, and Elseworlds movie The Batman: Part II . “Four years ago, we set out to unite DC under one creative vision," Gunn and Safran said in a statement. "In that time, we helped restore Superman to the heart of DC, while opening new doors and telling new stories in film and television with Peacemaker, Creature Commandos, Lanterns and Clayface. "We’re immensely proud of the team that turned that ambition into something real, including the actors, crews and executives we had the opportunity to collaborate with. "We’ve shared a creative history with Jeremy going back to Marvel, and we’re eager to see the perspective he brings to DC’s next chapter," Gunn and Safran said of their replacement at DC Studios. "We're excited to return to what drew us to this job in the first place, which is telling the stories we love, including the next chapter of Clark and Lex’s journey in Man of Tomorrow." In a separate, longer statement on Threads , Gunn said he's "incredibly relieved and excited to get back to pure filmmaking" and noted "the characters we set up will live on". Latcham is Marvel Studios' former senior VP of production and development, and was Kevin Feige's right-hand man at the company for a time, with credits on Iron Man, The Avengers, Guardians of the Galaxy and Spider-Man: Homecoming. As with Gunn and Safran, Latcham will oversee DC's film, TV and animation slate. "James and Peter launched a new era for DC Studios and led it through a period of real transformation, resetting the foundation and building a slate we’re incredibly proud of," Skydance bosses David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz said in a statement . "We're grateful for their passion, contributions and commitment to this legendary brand." Subscribe for a weekly digest of the movie and TV news that matters, direct to your inbox. From first-look trailers, interviews, reviews and explainers, we’ve got you covered. What the future now holds for DC is now less clear than ever. While several projects from the Gunn and Safran era are still in the pipeline, many were critical of Gunn and Safran's decision not to launch their shared universe with big-hitters like Batman and Wonder Woman, and instead focus on lesser-explored characters like Supergirl and Clayface. Could a creative reboot be on the cards, despite Gunn's Superman movies still being an ongoing concern? We'll soon find out. Man of Tomorrow releases on July 9, 2027. For more, here's all the upcoming DC movies and shows announced before Gunn's departure. I'm the Managing Editor, Entertainment here at GamesRadar+, overseeing the site's film and TV coverage. In a previous life as a print dinosaur, I was the Deputy Editor of Total Film magazine, and the news editor at SFX magazine. Fun fact: two of my favourite films released on the same day - Blade Runner and The Thing. stories.title: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais
stories.summary: The post Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais appeared first on Xbox Wire em Português .

sources.name: Xbox Wire BR
sources.title: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais
sources.text: A atualização mais pedida de Assassin’s Creed Valhalla já está disponível no XBOX Series X|S e no XBOX One. A atualização traz diversas novidades empolgantes ao jogo, oferecendo novas maneiras de aproveitar sua aventura viking. O grande destaque é a chegada do Novo Jogo+, um dos recursos mais pedidos pelos fãs de Assassin’s Creed Valhalla . As demais novidades do patch garantem que sua experiência após o fim da campanha e no Novo Jogo+ seja renovada e desafiadora, com recompensas que fazem tudo valer a pena. Confira o que esperar da atualização mais pedida: Conversamos com o designer-chefe de jogo, David Larouche, para saber mais sobre a atualização e como a equipe coloca os jogadores no centro de tudo o que faz. Quais novidades desta atualização são uma resposta direta aos comentários da comunidade? David Larouche : o Novo Jogo+ foi, sem dúvida, o recurso mais pedido pelos fãs. Assassin’s Creed Valhalla é um jogo imenso, mas, para algumas pessoas, jogar uma vez só não basta. Com esta atualização, estamos muito empolgados em permitir que nossos vikings mais dedicados vivam essa aventura novamente, mas, desta vez, com o personagem que tinham ao final da campanha. Como a equipe garantiu que os recursos pedidos atendessem às expectativas dos jogadores? DL : queríamos que a experiência do Novo Jogo+ não fosse apenas jogar tudo de novo; queríamos permitir que os jogadores continuassem aumentando seu poder, percebessem uma progressão em etapas menores e seguissem aprimorando seus personagens. Por todos esses motivos, adicionamos um modo de progressão estendida, mais melhorias para todas as peças de equipamento divino, uma nova categoria de runas e mais de 300 novas opções de bônus de runas que podem ser gravados na Forja de Runas — e todos esses recursos também estão disponíveis fora do Novo Jogo+. Com todas essas novidades, acreditamos que a experiência do Novo Jogo+ incentivará os jogadores a explorar todo o potencial de Eivor. Houve algum desafio inesperado na implementação dessas novidades? DL : acho que o mais surpreendente para nós foi justamente não termos encontrado nenhum grande desafio que nos deixasse sem saber como avançar. Conseguimos reunir uma equipe muito competente de desenvolvedores com experiência em adicionar o Novo Jogo+ a jogos já existentes; o processo de produção foi incrivelmente tranquilo. Há algum recurso que você esteja especialmente empolgado para ver no jogo? DL : com a atualização, transformamos praticamente todos os bônus presentes em itens em runas que podem ser gravadas na Forja de Runas, independentemente de terem sido lançados na experiência estendida, em uma expansão ou até mesmo na Loja. Mal posso esperar para ver como os jogadores vão combinar todos esses bônus e criar os mais variados tipos de sinergia. Tenho certeza de que há muitas combinações poderosíssimas a serem descobertas! Assassin’s Creed Valhalla recebeu sua última atualização de conteúdo há anos. Por que lançar a atualização mais pedida para os jogadores agora? DL : Valhalla pode ter recebido sua última atualização de conteúdo há anos, mas isso não significa que os jogadores deixaram de se importar com o jogo — e nós também não. Sabemos que o Novo Jogo+ é algo que a comunidade deseja há muito tempo e, quando surgiu a oportunidade de finalmente torná-lo realidade, mal podíamos esperar para seguir em frente. No fim das contas, trata-se de dar aos jogadores de longa data mais um motivo para voltar a um mundo ao qual dedicaram tanto tempo e reviver a jornada de Eivor sob uma nova perspectiva, levando consigo boa parte do que conquistaram pelo caminho. O fato de algum tempo ter passado não torna essa experiência menos significativa para nós nem, esperamos, para nossos jogadores. Qual é a importância da comunidade de Assassin’s Creed para a equipe da franquia? DL : a comunidade é extremamente importante para mim e para a equipe. Pessoalmente, acompanho as redes sociais com frequência para ver sobre o que os jogadores estão conversando e, como equipe, prestamos muita atenção aos comentários e às conversas pela internet. Adoramos ver o que os jogadores criam e compartilham sobre nossos jogos. Essa conexão com a comunidade é incrivelmente gratificante e é uma das principais razões pelas quais fazemos o que fazemos. Jogue hoje mesmo Assassin’s Creed Valhalla com a atualização mais pedida no XBOX Series X|S e no XBOX One.

stories.title: Everyone Spent N7 Day Fighting For Mass Effect’s Future
stories.summary: While previous years brought hope of updates on BioWare's beloved Mass Effect saga, this November had incensed fans pushing EA towards a course correction

sources.name: Kotaku
sources.title: Everyone Spent N7 Day Fighting For Mass Effect’s Future
sources.text: BioWare Electronic Arts Mass Effect Mass Effect: Universe Fourteen years ago, BioWare designated November 7th as N7 Day. Originally a commemoration for the original Mass Effect âs fifth anniversary, this yearâs festivities have become something of a funeral, with fans, developers, performers and even policy makers in attendance. Following the sudden closure of BioWare last month, and the subsequent materials about Mass Effect Universe that have surfaced , players are intensifying their push to do the series justice. Today is a very special day for Mass Effect fans. We've worked incredibly hard to bring together most of the original Mass Effect trilogy's voice cast to share a very important message with you. We need to #SaveMassEffect . pic.twitter.com/FOp0qp4wBI — We are Mass Effect – #SaveMassEffect (@WeAreMassEffect) November 7, 2026 âThe hardworking people who made Mass Effect deserve to see their vision through,â says Mass Effect composer Sam Hulick, joined by much of the gameâs cast in a video statement . âIâm not ready to see the story end either.â After years of quiet and conflict with the parent company, EA announced the unceremonious closure of BioWare, creators of Mass Effect , Dragon Age , and more. It comes amid a controversial acquisition of EA from a consortium of private equity holders, including the Saudi Arabia Public Investment Fund and Jared Kushnerâs Affinity Partners. Adding insult to injury, the shuttering dropped just a few weeks before N7 day, which in the past had fans awaiting for any news regarding the Mass Effect series . Obviously, no one was on standby for such a party this year, even though evidence suggests EA had already brought decorations . Instead, incensed stalwarts took the opportunity to intensify their campaign to save the series. After purchasing ad space in Times Square , more billboards and trucks for the “Save Mass Effect ” movement have emerged in Wales, Texas, California and Edmonton, the latter being BioWareâs stomping grounds. On top of the series’ own alumni, various other developers and voice performers have joined in. Five Nights At Freddy âs Kellen Goff shared his thoughts on the importance of the series and the movementâs efforts thus far. Owlcat Games released their own video reminiscing on the series, having just hired Dragon Age writer David Gaider to work on Osiris Reborn , their own RPG based on the sci-fi series The Expanse . One of the more unexpected fronts of support come from Canadaâs New Democratic Party. Newly elected party leader Avi Lewis expressed his frustrations with EA and private equity when the closure was first announced, suggesting stronger policy to protect Canadian businesses and even suggesting the federal government intervene in BioWareâs future. While there already is plenty of Canadian funding wrapped up in the gaming industry (see: Ubisoft), NDP member of parliament Don Davies boosted support for the petition, as well as photoshopping his head on Commander Sheppard . BioWare is an Edmonton-based video game studio that created acclaimed series like #MassEffect , Baldurâs Gate, and Dragon Age. Canadaâs video game industry creates some of our most important cultural exports, and #BioWare was among our greatest success stories. (1/3) pic.twitter.com/KeL6LeRzuW — Don Davies (@DonDavies) November 6, 2026 The major front for N7 day appears to be Mass Effect itself. If the petition signatures arenât convincing, theyâre hoping for a high count of simultaneous players on the original game will make a stronger case . Regardless of what course correction is even possible at this point , fans are making themselves unignorable, as billboard trucks roam outside of EAâs Redwood headquarters, Madrid offices are tagged and the announcement of massive back catalogue restoration, which would have been really cool if not for everything else, is drowned out by commenters . Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: "Something's really possible" - Mass Effect cast rally around efforts to save the franchise on the first N7 Day after BioWare's closure
sources.text: I'm Commander Shepard and this is my favorite video on the internet. This N7 Day was the first without developer BioWare around, but fans of the Mass Effect series didn't let 7th November go by quietly. The community managed to get several notable Mass Effect actors to lend their voice to the increasingly loud 'SaveMassEffect' movement. In the weeks since BioWare's shock closure and Mass Effect Universe's cancellation , the community-organised We Are Mass Effect group have put up billboards in Times Square , a mobile billboard outside BioWare Edmonton's former office and much more while directing attention to an online petition . Today is a very special day for Mass Effect fans. We've worked incredibly hard to bring together most of the original Mass Effect trilogy's voice cast to share a very important message with you. We need to #SaveMassEffect. https://t.co/FOp0qp4wBI And for the series' annual celebration, the group managed to get a sizable portion of the Mass Effect cast to join in. Commander Shepard actors Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer, original trilogy composer Sam Hulick, Garrus' Brandon Keener, Jack's Courtnay Taylor, Tali'Zorah's Ash Sroka, Thane's Keythe Farley and many more all showed up in a two-minute video to help potentially salvage the series - sometimes in character. "When we heard about the formal closing of Boware, I felt weirdly hopeful," Hale said in a separate interview with IGN . "I can't explain it. I just got so weirdly hopeful. My first thought, of course, was for the devs and all the people. And then I just closed my eyes and crossed my fingers and I said, 'I feel something's possible. You know, something's really possible.'" The other half of Commander Shepard, Mark Meer, noted that "this didn't all just happen in the last 10 days." Near yearly layoffs at EA had slowly trimmed multiple BioWare teams down, sometimes even affecting studio veterans who had been at the company for decades. "A lot of senior writers within the last year or two were let go. People who had been there from the very beginning. Again, people who had built that company from the ground up, who built the bones of it, who made those games that had captured people so much right back from the 1990s," Meer said.

sources.text: Mais uma semana que começa com a nossa lista de lançamentos para que você possa se programar para os próximos dias. O grande destaque dessa vez é Sonic Pico Park , game do icônico personagem em uma abordagem nunca antes vista, que mistura elementos de puzzle com cooperação entre os personagens. Outro destaque é Shrek 2 Remastered . Como o nome sugere, ele é uma remasterização de um dos games mais elogiados do famoso ogro dos cinemas, que conta com melhorias nos gráficos e no desempenho. Confira a lista completa de lançamentos da semana e os respectivos preços. Shrek 2 Remastered é uma versão remasterizada do jogo de aventura lançado originalmente para a geração 128 bits , no PlayStation 2 e Nintendo GameCube. O título acompanha o ogro e seus amigos em fases baseadas na história do segundo filme da franquia de animação, passando por locais como o pântano e o reino de Tão Tão Distante. A jogabilidade permite alternar entre quatro personagens durante as missões , cada um com habilidades específicas para resolver puzzles no cenário e avançar na história. O lançamento traz melhorias gráficas e suporte para resolução atualizada, além de manter o foco no modo cooperativo local para até quatro pessoas. O game já está em pré-venda a partir de R$ 87,29. Football Manager 27 é o novo capítulo da franquia anual de simulação e gerenciamento de futebol , que é desenvolvida pela Sports Interactive. O jogador assume o papel de treinador e gerente de um clube, e precisa lidar com as responsabilidades do cargo, d esde a montagem do elenco até o controle das finanças e o relacionamento com a imprensa. A edição deste ano atualiza os elencos, ligas e competições para a temporada atual do futebol mundial. O título oferece ferramentas de análise de dados para ajustar táticas antes e durante as partidas e traz sistemas de observação para contratar novos jogadores e desenvolver talentos nas categorias de base do time. OBS: Por motivos de licenciamento, o jogo não é vendido de forma oficial no Brasil. Warhammer Survivors é um jogo de ação com visão isométrica, inspirado no fenômeno Vampire Survivors. O formato segue o estilo de sobrevivência, no qual os ataques acontecem de forma automática e o foco está na movimentação pelo cenário, enquanto o jogador enfrenta hordas contínuas de inimigos em arenas fechadas. O título reúne mais de 40 campeões extraídos dos universos de Warhammer 40,000 e Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Durante as partidas, é necessário coletar recursos deixados pelos oponentes derrotados para subir de nível e escolher novas armas e habilidades. O game ainda não possui um preço definido, mas já conta com uma versão demo que pode ser baixada de forma gratuita. Sonic Pico Park é um jogo de ação e quebra-cabeça focado no modo multijogador cooperativo. A proposta une os personagens da franquia do ouriço da Sega com as mecânicas de colaboração em grupo vistas no título independente Pico Park original. Para completar cada fase, os participantes precisam coordenar seus movimentos e realizar ações conjuntas, como empilhar os personagens para alcançar locais mais altos ou ativar botões simultaneamente. O progresso exige comunicação constante entre os jogadores , pois falhas individuais resultam no reinício do nível atual. O jogo ainda não possui um preço definido. Barbie Rewind é uma coletânea focada na preservação histórica de títulos antigos da boneca da Mattel, desenvolvida pela Digital Eclipse e publicada pela Atari. O pacote conta com os seguintes jogos: Seguindo o modelo de outros projetos da desenvolvedora, a coleção funciona como um museu virtual interativo, trazendo artes conceituais, documentos de bastidores e materiais de acervo sobre o desenvolvimento dos jogos. O game ainda não possui um preço definido. E na sua opinião, qual o game mais esperado da semana? Conte para a gente nas redes sociais do Voxel!
